response.sql: WITH joined_data AS (SELECT s.healtheval FROM scanconservation sc INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), status_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(healtheval, 'missing') as status, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM joined_data GROUP BY COALESCE(healtheval, 'missing')), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_cnt FROM status_counts), shares AS (SELECT status, cnt, CAST(cnt AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total_cnt FROM total_count) as share FROM status_counts), avg_share_calc AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares), above_avg AS (SELECT status, cnt, share FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_calc)) SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_calc)) as avg_excess FROM above_avg
